📋 ISSUE
────────
MCP servers in .vscode/mcp.json work in VS Code but don't load in Copilot Workspace

🔍 ROOT CAUSE
─────────────
VS Code:             .vscode/mcp.json (workspace-local) ✅
Copilot Workspace:   ~/.config/copilot/mcp.json (user-level) ❌ Missing

Different execution contexts → Different config locations

⚡ QUICK FIX
────────────
Linux/macOS:  mkdir -p ~/.config/copilot && cp .vscode/mcp.json ~/.config/copilot/
Windows:      Copy-Item ".vscode\mcp.json" "$env:APPDATA\GitHub\Copilot\mcp.json"
